summary: Preprint Supplemental Fig. 1b reports male- and female-biased expression across the 530 P10 cells passing the initial filter. HypoExplorer sums 467 retained VMH neurons into six mouse pseudobulks and estimates male-minus-female expression across animals. The published cluster markers and adult in situ measurements also answer different questions.

manualReview.summary: The Figure 2 source-data CSV identifies the 467 P10 VMH cells used by HypoExplorer. The preprint’s sex-bias plot includes 63 additional cells from the same six mice and groups the observations by cell sex.
manualReview.note: The GEO count archive and the Figure 2 CSV each match their historical checksum. Of 576 wells, 261 female and 269 male cells pass the initial QC gate. Although the published Figure 2e caption says 530 cells, its CSV contains 467 unique IDs across six clusters. The authors’ code removes the Apoe and Pomc clusters before plotting the heatmap. All 467 IDs pass QC, yielding 237 female and 230 male cells from three mice per sex. The registered edgeR quasi-likelihood model uses one summed count vector per mouse and estimates male minus female. Preprint Supplemental Figure 1b compares the broader set of cells by sex. The published marker test compares a cluster with the other clusters, and Figure 3a–d measures optical density in separate adult animals. The Correa Lab browser provides gene-expression plots and gene-pair co-expression.
reviewFlags: The sources reviewed yielded no author gene effect for the retained P10 VMH population with mice as biological replicates. Effect agreement, P-value agreement and FDR agreement for the registered contrast remain unassessed.

The current compressed GEO SOFT differs from the historical checksum. Its tissue, age, sex, genotype, GSM identifiers and file links support the same cohort. The checksum match applies to the count archive and Figure 2 CSV.

verificationReview.reason: Preprint Supplemental Figure 1b groups 530 P10 cells by sex. Positive average logFC denotes male-biased expression, and the legend colors genes by adjusted P < 0.05. The preprint does not specify the log base or the test for this panel. HypoExplorer estimates a male-minus-female log2 fold change from the 467 retained VMH cells, with three independent mice per arm. The authors’ cluster markers, adult regional optical-density contrasts and expression browser provide no paired gene effects for this mouse-level comparison.
verificationReview.nextStep: Reopen if an author result estimates male versus female P10 VMH expression with mice as biological replicates. Check the Figure 2 cell membership or document a compatible cohort, the female baseline, and how the model weights cells and animals. Record the gene scope and effect definition, and assess P values and FDR where available.
